newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Norilsk Nickel shares soar. [CORRECTED 10:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Russia's Norilsk Nickel shares soar. [CORRECTED 10:55 GMT]

text.p: Privileged shares in Russian mining and smelting giant RAO Norilsky Nikel shot up 22 percent (corrects from 48 percent) early on Wednesday and ordinary shares rose 15 percent (corrects from 18 percent) from Tuesday's close.

Preferred shares had rocketed to $11.25 by 0825 GMT from $9.20 (corrects from $7.60). Ordinaries rose to $13.40 from $11.65 (corrects from 11.30). Traders said the rise took place on aggressive buying by one market player ahead of a July 22 tender of a 38 percent stake in Norilsk.
